tagline: Two attacks in a single swing — and eight of his cards get better once he wins one

featuredCards.title: Momentous Lunge
featuredCards.caption: Cross a zone and the 2 becomes a 6. Closing distance is the whole cost of his biggest hit.

featuredCards.title: Arrogant but Effective
featuredCards.caption: Declares itself a win no matter what happened. That unlocks the rest of the deck on demand.

featuredCards.title: Unrelenting Advance
featuredCards.caption: After a win, take back a card you already played this turn. His best cards get played twice.

featuredCards.title: Fear, Surprise, & Intimidation
featuredCards.caption: Two effects normally, all three once he has won — movement, recursion, cards and an action in one card.
